news.title: The House of Abhinandan Lodha & NITCO to jointly develop mixed-use project in Alibaug
news.para: The House of Abhinandan Lodha, through its subsidiary HoABL Impactum Land, has signed an MoU with NITCO, NITCO Realties and promoter Vivek Talwar to develop land parcels in Alibaug. The project is expected to generate ₹3,000 crore revenue for HoABL and ₹1,500 crore for NITCO over five years.

news.title: Schindler India launches new experience centre in Gurugram; reinforcing our commitment to sustainable urban mobility
news.para: Schindler India has unveiled its new Experience Centre in Gurugram, highlighting advancements in vertical mobility solutions. During the launch, a panel of experts deliberated on creating sustainable, interconnected urban spaces in the Delhi-NCR region by 2030. They stressed the importance of transit-oriented development, walkable neighborhoods, and eco-friendly construction practices, while also calling for supportive policies. Schindler reaffirmed its commitment to Net Zero and introduced an environmentally conscious maintenance contract.

news.title: Property tax powers Chandigarh civic body's ₹134 crore own revenue haul
news.para: During the months of April to June, property tax became a cornerstone of the Chandigarh municipal corporation's finances, yielding over Rs 134 crore in revenue. This surge was partly due to timely rebates provided to taxpayers. The civic authority, however, faced expenses of Rs 254 crore, primarily from salaries. A notable amount was dedicated to crucial development initiatives, particularly in road construction and upgrades.

news.title: Gurugram: 450 families in Imperia Esfera rely on diesel generator set as snag sparks outages
news.para: The inhabitants of Imperia Esfera in Gurgaon are facing an ongoing nightmare of power outages that have persisted for three days, impacting about 450 residences. Continuous electrical issues have rendered their temporary 11-kV power connection inefficient. In a bid for clarity and permanence, residents are calling for a collaborative investigation to pinpoint responsibility.

news.title: Puravankara to jointly develop 7.83-acre land parcel in Bengaluru
news.para: Puravankara has entered into a joint development agreement for a 7.83-acre land parcel in southeast Bengaluru. The project has an estimated gross development value of ₹1,100 crore and a saleable area of about 0.89 million sq ft.

news.title: Change in revenue record doesn't create, end property title: SC
news.para: The Supreme Court has established that mutations in revenue records do not establish ownership of property. The ruling quashed an order from the Madhya Pradesh High Court, highlighting that disputes over titles require evidence beyond mere revenue entries, which serve only fiscal purposes and do not imply rights. Civil courts retain the authority to ascertain the actual title while revenue entries are maintained separately.

news.title: Over 800 unauthorised buildings identified across Cyberabad civic body limits
news.para: The Cyberabad Municipal Corporation has uncovered more than 800 unauthorized constructions across its three zones, with Kukatpally zone showing the highest number at 365 violations. Enforcement measures, including show-cause notices, demolitions, and seizures, have been initiated. Many building owners exploit loopholes to bypass regulations. The civic body strongly encourages residents to report any violations via the My CURE app.

news.title: Two Parsi bungalows in Mumbai's Perry Cross Road to make way for luxury towers
news.para: Two Parsi-owned bungalows in Bandra's Perry Cross Road will be demolished. Supreme Universal plans to build two luxury towers on the prime one-acre plot. The sale potential of this significant coastal development is estimated at Rs 1,500 crore.

news.title: DTCP issues 1,300 fresh notices, over 600 restoration orders in Gurugram
news.para: The Department of Town and Country Planning in Gurgaon is ramping up its enforcement actions. Established residential neighborhoods are now facing show-cause notices and restoration orders as part of a crackdown on unauthorized construction and commercial property misuse. Ongoing demolition and sealing activities are ongoing citywide, emphasizing the necessity for property owners to conform to sanctioned plans and proper land utilization.

news.title: Joint ownership of flat with spouse does not mean that tax sop should be equally divided: ITAT
news.para: The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal has made it clear that owning property jointly does not restrict a taxpayer's eligibility for full exemption. They highlighted that the actual investment made by the taxpayer is what matters for exemptions. In a case where an individual sought total exemption for a jointly acquired residential property, the tax authorities had limited it to fifty percent.

news.title: IRP and buyers' representative of Supertech Basera suspended in Gurugram
news.para: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI) has suspended the registration of the resolution professional responsible for Supertech Basera for two years. Furthermore, the homebuyers' representative saw their registration revoked as well. This dual regulatory action necessitates new appointments for both representatives, leaving buyers of the delayed project waiting eagerly for updates towards a feasible completion strategy.

news.title: Promoters need majority  consent to modify amenities: Karnataka REAT
news.para: The Karnataka Real Estate Appellate Tribunal has reversed a K-RERA decision involving the Sobha Sentosa property. Homebuyers claimed that the promoter altered approved plans and project elements without their consent. The tribunal dismissed the homebuyers' appeal while granting the promoter's appeal. The promoter defended against RERA claims and communicated delays to buyers. This ruling significantly affects ongoing disputes related to property specifications and promoter responsibilities.

news.title: Australian developer Bathla Group calls administrators, citing 'perfect storm'
news.para: Bathla Group, an Australian property developer, has appointed external administrators for restructuring due to declining sales and increasing costs. Recent government tax reforms aimed at improving housing affordability have further complicated the situation. Despite these challenges, the company is determined to maintain its housing supply in its core market, highlighting the ongoing instability within the Australian housing industry.

news.title: Zillow settles FTC claims it paid Redfin to stop competing on apartment listings
news.para: Zillow and Redfin have reached a settlement with the FTC and five states regarding their controversial rental ad partnership. The agreement concludes allegations that they unfairly inflated advertising expenses. As part of the settlement, Redfin will work to revamp its rental advertising operations within six months, contributing to US authorities' wider efforts to tackle housing costs and bolster competition in online rental listings.

news.title: Mumbai: BMC starts demolition of unauthorised alterations inside some flats in Rustomjee Crown
news.para: Mumbai's civic officials have launched a demolition operation against unauthorized constructions at Rustomjee Crown, acting on various complaints regarding illegal modifications and joined apartments. After issuing several prior warnings, demolition efforts began on Monday, affecting three flats, and carried out under police oversight. The operation aims to extend over the next few days, focusing on maintaining the integrity of the residential building.

news.title: HC pulls up Uttar Pradesh housing agency over delay in compliance with UP-RERA order
news.para: The Allahabad High Court criticized the UP housing agency for its compliance delays.  The agency issued a cheque for a lesser amount than ordered by UPRERA.  The court directed the Housing Commissioner to appear and explain the discrepancy.  This action followed a complaint filed by Ashok Kumar Singh before UPRERA.  The court ordered the cheque amount to be released to the petitioner.

news.title: CBI files 18th chargesheet against builder, directors in homebuyers fraud case
news.para: The CBI has unveiled its eighteenth chargesheet regarding a homebuyer fraud case, targeting a builder and several directors, as well as financial institution executives. This case pertains to deceptive actions surrounding a housing project in West Bengal. The chargesheet has been filed in the CBI Special Court located in Alipore, with the agency actively pursuing thirty-one more analogous cases across the country.

news.title: SC bans construction activity within 100 metres from edge of Rajasthan's Jojari river
news.para: In a landmark decision, the Supreme Court has imposed a ban on any construction activities within 100 metres of Rajasthan's Jojari-Bandi-Luni rivers to safeguard the environment. Additionally, hazardous industries will be restricted from operating within 500 metres of the flood line. A research initiative at National Law University, Jodhpur will delve into environmental law and community rights, funded by a grant of fifty lakh rupees.

news.title: Goa: Development in eco fragile land, tenants issue spark Mandur gram sabha
news.para: During the recent Azossim-Mandur gram sabha meeting, attendees addressed the proposed large-scale project on Azossim hill and its potential environmental consequences. Discussions also included tenant management and issues surrounding littering in rental properties. A controversial new road route through a verdant forest was debated, alongside occupancy certificates issued previously. The sarpanch committed to tackling the deteriorating Pilar-Old Goa road and the necessary BMC reconstitution.

news.title: Delhi development body to hold over 20 meetings in three months over MPD 2047
news.para: The Delhi Development Authority is gearing up for more than twenty stakeholder meetings in the near future. These critical dialogues will hone in on executing the Master Plan for Delhi 2047, welcoming contributions from elected officials, governmental organizations, industry representatives, and local residents alike. Furthermore, updates to the Delhi Development Act are set to support the swift rollout of the land pooling policy.
